status: Conditional planning scenario, not actual revenue, signed customers, invoices, or an approved price
limits: Only the provider tariff references and VM/backup prices are externally sourced; customer counts, usage, proposed price, hours and budgets are explicit planning assumptions.
The current local deployment has no measured paid API invoice, paying customers or approved subscription price.
The billable output assumption includes thinking tokens. Actual usage metadata must be measured before committing to a price.
The model tariff is a published reference for Gemini 3.5 Flash, not a guarantee of future prices or the project's bill. Rates and availability must be rechecked at purchase.
The 8 GiB CPU VM is a reference configuration; supported concurrency and tenant capacity have not been load-tested.
The cash-flow scenario holds five organizations and all prices constant from month one, with no acquisition ramp, churn, inflation or tax. It is not a sales forecast.
No real employment agreement or cost ledger establishes the hourly budget. Hardening is a proposed launch budget, not historical development spend.
Billing, per-organization monthly usage quotas and commercial plans are future work. This scenario does not represent implemented billing.
